skill.enemy.eldritch.dread_gaze.rule: Remove up to 4 Guard from the effective recipient, then deal 9 plus level raw damage through any Guard that remains.

animationBeats.pose: The tide spawn unfolds an eye that should not exist and turns its full attention on the target, motionless.
The stare widens past focus; the target's guarded stance visibly begins to waver.
A cold pressure crosses the space between them, bending the target's posture inward.
The target's guard breaks outward in dim, guttering shards rather than bronze light.
The pressure follows through as a raw blow the target has no composure left to absorb.
The tide spawn lets the stare go and the air around it settles, ready again.

skill.enemy.eldritch.dread_gaze.framing: Keep the full figure, both hands, the target line and the impact effect inside the battle safe frame for every beat.

text.firstObservation: The tide spawn is what the sealed containment channel was built to hold back: a shape the eye keeps sliding off, patient in a way nothing wild should be.

intentTells.skill.enemy.eldritch.dread_gaze: An eye that should not exist opens somewhere on its unstable shape and fixes on the weakest stance in the party -- a dread gaze beginning.

art.framing: Entire unstable form, the open eye and the guard-break effect remain inside the battle safe frame; no cosmic-horror gore.
